# ropodl

> ropodl is the portfolio and writing site of Saroj Poudel, a software engineer, full-stack developer, and designer based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

This site presents Saroj's background, selected projects, and writing about frontend development, design, and building for the web. Public pages are available in English.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://ropodl.com/): Overview, recent writing, and selected projects.
- [About](https://ropodl.com/about): Background, experience, skills, and approach to design and development.
- [Projects](https://ropodl.com/projects): Published project work and case studies.
- [Blog](https://ropodl.com/blogs): Published articles and notes.
- [Contact](https://ropodl.com/contact): Contact information and project inquiries.

## Feeds and indexes

- [XML sitemap](https://ropodl.com/sitemap.xml): Current public pages, projects, and published articles.
- [RSS feed](https://ropodl.com/feed.xml): Recent published articles.

Use the canonical HTTPS URLs above when citing this site. Project and article details can change; consult their current pages for the latest information.
